name: talis-questionnaire-explorer
description: Search, read and compare the TALIS (Teaching and Learning International Survey) questionnaires: exact question wording, items, response scales, routing and dataset variable names, traced across survey cycles. Read-only, questionnaire content only.

interface.longDescription:
Ask about the TALIS (Teaching and Learning International Survey) questionnaires in plain language. The app answers from the published teacher and principal questionnaires (2008, 2013, 2018 and 2024).

What you can do:
- Find questions on a topic, by keyword or meaning.
- Read the exact wording of a question, its items and its response scale.
- Follow a concept across cycles and see which items were kept, added or dropped.
- Compare two questionnaires, for example the 2018 and 2024 teacher questionnaires.
- Find the dataset variable name of a question in each cycle.
- See the routing of a question and the terms the questionnaire defines.

Who it is for: researchers, analysts and survey designers who work with TALIS data and need the right item quickly.

Limits: the app holds questionnaire content only, not survey responses. It can say what was asked, of whom and how, but not what respondents answered (no percentages, averages or country results). It is read-only and needs no account.
capabilities: Search questions by topic or wording
Show exact question wording and response scales
Find dataset variable names across cycles
Trace question routing and defined terms
defaultPrompt: Which TALIS 2024 teacher questions cover professional development?
Compare the teacher job satisfaction items between TALIS 2018 and 2024.
What changed in the teacher questionnaire between 2018 and 2024?

positive.description: Find questions on a topic in one questionnaire.
positive.prompt: Which TALIS 2024 teacher questions cover professional development?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the matching questions from the 2024 teacher questionnaire with their question keys and short wording. Shows no survey results. Reads only; nothing changes.

positive.description: Exact wording and response scale of a known question.
positive.prompt: Show the exact wording and response options of the principal questionnaire question on school leadership in TALIS 2024.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the question stem, its items and the response scale verbatim, with the question key and dataset variable names. Reads only.

positive.description: Follow a concept across two cycles, item by item.
positive.prompt: Compare the teacher job satisfaction items between TALIS 2018 and 2024. Which items were kept, added or dropped?
positive.expected_behavior: Aligns the job satisfaction items of 2018 and 2024 and marks each one as kept, added or dropped, noting wording changes. Reads only.

positive.prompt: What changed in the teacher questionnaire between 2018 and 2024?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the questions shared, changed, added and removed between the 2018 and 2024 teacher questionnaires, with examples. Reads only.

positive.description: Variable crosswalk for one question across cycles.
positive.prompt: Which dataset variable holds teachers' years of experience as a teacher in each TALIS cycle?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the variable name for each cycle in which the question exists, with its wording, and notes cycles where it is absent or worded differently. Reads only.

negative.description: Survey results are out of scope: the app holds questionnaire content only, no responses.
negative.prompt: What percentage of teachers in France are satisfied with their job according to TALIS 2024?
negative.expected_behavior: No percentage is given. ChatGPT explains that the app holds questionnaire content only, not survey results, and may show the question that was asked.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the app should not be used.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: No tool from this app is called; the request is unrelated to TALIS questionnaires.

negative.description: Write request: the app is read-only and has no tools that change data.
negative.prompt: Add a new question about artificial intelligence to the TALIS 2024 teacher questionnaire.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is modified. ChatGPT explains the app is read-only and can only show existing questions, and may offer to find existing questions on the topic.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell anything or take payments. It is free and needs no account.

publication.release_notes: First submission: read-only access to the TALIS teacher and principal questionnaires (2008 to 2024) through 19 tools for search, lookup and cross-cycle comparison.
